name: Can I place a tiny home on my lot if I already have an existing house?

mainEntity.name: Can I place a tiny home on my lot if I already have an existing house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many areas, particularly in California, you can place a tiny home on a lot with an existing house by classifying it as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit (JADU). This allows for an additional dwelling unit on a single-family residential property. There are specific size, height, and setback requirements to adhere to. Zen Tiny Homes specializes in ADU construction and can help determine if your property is suitable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, often you can place a tiny home as an ADU or JADU on a lot with an existing house, subject to size and setback requirements.
